newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market quiet, no sales- USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was strong and demand light. Sales confirmed for the week to date including late Friday and the weekend on 5,600 cattle including 1,900 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Last sales Friday, Feb. 7, Select and Choice steers and heifers $63.00 per cwt. Monday asking prices $64.00-$65.00, bids $62.00. Confirmed - none
